summary: AI-powered transaction categorizer for Actual Budget
description: Fetches uncategorized transactions from Actual Budget, uses Ollama to suggest categories based on payee names and amounts, and updates the transactions with matched categories

ollama_model.description: Ollama model name to use for categorization

account_name.description: Optional: only categorize transactions in this account. Leave empty for all accounts.

lookback_days.description: Number of days to look back for uncategorized transactions

dry_run.description: If true, show suggested categories without updating transactions
